title: Volunteer listing
description: One volunteer shift or event in the shared event format. Plain-language guide: docs/EVENT-FORMAT.md. Unknown values: join_method and spanish_spoken use the string "unknown"; every other field that may be unknown uses null. A field never has two ways to say unknown.

id.description: Stable across runs: a hash of source_id and the source's own event id.

org_name.description: The organization's name, as the organization writes it.

title.description: Title of the shift or event, in the language the organization wrote it.

start.description: Start date and time, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: End date and time, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. null when the source gives no end time.

address.description: Street address as published by the organization. null when not given.

area.description: Area id from the city's own settings file (areas[].id). Never a free-typed place name.

neighborhood_or_town.description: Neighborhood or town, finer than area. null when not known.

cause.description: What the work is for, for example food or environment. null when not known.

sensitive.description: true for every protest_action listing, anything immigration-related, and anything flagged sensitive. When unsure, true.

photos_allowed.description: false when the listing is marked "no photos". Write true when the source says nothing.

signup_url.description: The organization's own page for joining. Sign-ups never happen on the hub.

join_method.description: What a volunteer must do before turning up. drop_in: just show up. signup: reserve a place, no reply needed. application: apply and wait for an answer. unknown: the source does not say; shown as "check with the organizer". Never guess.

min_age.description: Youngest age allowed, in whole years. null when the source does not say.

listing_language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the language the organization wrote the listing in, for example en or es.

spanish_spoken.description: Whether Spanish is spoken at the shift. "unknown" when the source does not say. Never guess.

training_required.description: Whether training is needed before the shift. null when the source does not say.

clearances_required.description: Whether background checks or clearances are needed. null when the source does not say.

group_friendly.description: Whether groups are welcome. null when the source does not say.

recurring.description: true when the shift repeats on a schedule.

recurrence_rule.description: iCalendar RRULE (RFC 5545), without the "RRULE:" prefix, for example FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=3TH. Set only when the source or the poster gives the schedule. null otherwise.

source_url.description: The public page the facts came from.

source_id.description: Id of the source entry in the city's source list.

last_seen_at.description: When the pipeline last saw this listing on its source. Shown as "last checked".

allOf.description: A schedule can only be given for a recurring listing.
